# ── Release-draft sweeper (issue #282) ────────────────────────────────────
  # Hygiene leg: no pipeline step may leave a draft release behind (the
  # 3-week-old v0.1.190 rot). The per-job guards in build-macos/build-mobile
  # own the failure path; this sweeper is the daily backstop — anything that
  # slips through (a cancelled run, a path without a guard) is deleted after
  # 24h and a deduplicated self-closing issue names the creating run so a
  # RECURRING stuck draft points at its broken step instead of rotting.
  # Runs on every daily (and manual) invocation regardless of leg results —
  # change-gating must not gate hygiene.
  sweep-drafts:
    name: Sweep stale release drafts
    needs: plan
    if: always() # even when plan failed or all legs skipped
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write # delete draft releases
      actions: read # name each swept draft's creating run (gh run list 403s without it, review of #294)
      issues: write # deduplicated self-closing sweep issue
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Delete drafts older than 24h and file the dedup issue
        run: bash scripts/sweep_stale_drafts.sh

  # ── Report + self-healing issues ─────────────────────────────────────────
  report:
    name: Summary + self-filed issues
    needs: [plan, testflight, play, pubdev, cli, website, addin]
    if: always() # runs even when plan failed, so plan failures enter the self-healing loop too
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Job summary table and issue lifecycle
        env:
          NEXT_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT: ${{ needs.testflight.result }}
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT_URL: ${{ needs.testflight.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PLAY: ${{ needs.play.result }}
          LEG_PLAY_URL: ${{ needs.play.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PUBDEV: ${{ needs.pubdev.result }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_STATUS: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.status }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBSPEC: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.pubspec_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBLISHED: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.published_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_URL: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_CLI: ${{ needs.cli.result }}
          LEG_CLI_URL: ${{ needs.cli.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_WEBSITE: ${{ needs.website.result }}
          LEG_WEBSITE_URL: ${{ needs.website.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_ADDIN: ${{ needs.addin.result }}
          LEG_ADDIN_URL: ${{ needs.addin.outputs.run_url }}
        run: bash scripts/daily_publish_report.sh

      # gh-1478: the inject_failure TEST hook must prove the filed digest
      # QUOTES the injected ::error:: line (signal-first excerpt via the
      # per-job log endpoint), not merely that an issue exists — the #1473
      # tree-noise regression class.
      # The `!= ''` guard matters: on schedule triggers the `inputs` context
      # is EMPTY (the dispatch `default: none` does not apply), so gating
      # only on `!= 'none'` would run — and fail — this step every cron run.
      - name: Verify injected-failure excerpt (TEST)
        if: always() && inputs.inject_failure != '' && inputs.inject_failure != 'none'
        env:
          INJECTED: ${{ inputs.inject_failure }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          title="[daily-publish] ${INJECTED} leg failed"
          n=$(gh issue list --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --state open \
                --label daily-publish --limit 200 \
                --json number,title --jq '.[] | [.number, .title] | @tsv' \
                | while IFS=$'\t' read -r num t; do
                    [ "$t" = "$title" ] && echo "$num"
                  done | head -1)
          if [ -z "$n" ]; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: no open issue titled '${title}' — the self-filing path regressed"
            exit 1
          fi
          text=$(gh issue view "$n" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
                   --json body,comments --jq '.body, (.comments[]?.body // empty)')
          if ! grep -qF "injected failure (inject_failure=${INJECTED})" <<< "$text"; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: issue #${n} never quotes the injected ::error:: line — the signal-first excerpt regressed (gh-1478)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "inject_failure verify OK: issue #${n} quotes the injected error line (gh-1478)"

#               loud-failure detector (e.g. expired publish credentials)

#                                 fa1.dev publish itself rides the website

#

# change is green-neutral, never red (#159 lesson). One exception (gh-1192):

# green must not become a skip baseline that stalls re-verification and

# existing scheme: auto_release.sh patch-bumps + tags every main push

# tag and verifies/republishes pub.dev. See docs/ci.md.

# gh-1847: the tag train builds fa-extension.zip ITSELF. The leg
  # mirrors web-spa (additive attach, quality-gate keyed) because the
  # failure mode it kills is identical in shape: the extension's former
  # ONLY producer was build-macos.yml build-extension, a once-daily leg
  # deriving "latest+1 at its own dispatch moment" — any v* tag train
  # landing after the daily leg published a draft WITHOUT fa-extension.zip
  # and the gh-1832 required-assets gate correctly stranded it
  # (v1.0.637/v1.0.638 stuck, 2026-10-24; the manual recovery dispatch
  # from memory note n_1012 risked becoming the operating mode). With the
  # train producing the zip, the gate's precondition is met by the train
  # no matter when the daily leg ran; the daily leg keeps pre-staging the
  # next-tag draft and stays the n_1012 emergency producer.
  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension (release)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 30
    # Additive REQUIRED asset, same semantics as web-spa: an SDK flake or
    # vendor-fetch hiccup must NOT hold CLI provenance hostage — the
    # release-provenance required-assets gate (gh-1832) is the single
    # publish blocker and strands the draft loudly on the MISSING asset
    # (previous release stays latest). continue-on-error keeps the check
    # green; the failed steps stay visible on the run page.
    continue-on-error: true
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) ||
      github.event_name == 'release')
    permissions:
      contents: write # attach fa-extension.zip to the GitHub Release
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Blobless full history: the lazy draft create (gh-1801 rework)
          # builds the release body via scripts/release_notes.sh — same
          # reason as the web-spa job's checkout (gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      # gh-1684 decision 4 + #1431 exact-patch pin: the SAME pinned SDK
      # every other fa-extension.zip leg carries (extension-size-gate,
      # build-macos.yml build-extension) — the rev normalization absorbs
      # canvaskit/skwasm churn, the pin keeps every build comparable.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as the PR-time
      # extension-size-gate leg and build-macos.yml build-extension.
      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what the landing page's releases/latest/download link
      # serves. Identical invocation as the PR-time gate leg (gh-1684 AC3)
      # and the build-macos.yml release leg.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096) + gh-1684 AC5: one baseline, one enforcement rule — the
      # IDENTICAL invocation the extension-size-gate PR leg and the
      # build-macos.yml release leg run, gate BEFORE upload (a budget
      # regression must not reach the release assets). Baseline is
      # committed — no --init-if-missing here.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      # gh-1801 (rework): DRAFT-first, NEVER publish here. fa-extension.zip
      # is a gh-1832 REQUIRED asset, but even a complete asset set must not
      # go live without the SIGNED SHA256SUMS — only the tag-run
      # release-provenance job owns the --draft=false --latest flip. Create
      # the draft with the curated notes + the draft-owner marker and
      # upload; --clobber keeps the stable asset name pointing at the
      # newest build. No guard step ON PURPOSE (same reasoning as web-spa):
      # this job is continue-on-error — on failure the train (binaries →
      # provenance) CONTINUES and must find the draft alive; a genuinely
      # orphaned draft is reclaimed by the 24h sweeper.
      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"
          bash scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          gh release upload "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Mirror of the web-spa summary flag: surface the miss in the run's
      # step summary (covers build/size-gate/upload flakes); the failed
      # steps remain visible in the job view. The release-provenance
      # required-assets gate is what actually blocks the publish.
      - name: Flag missing extension in step summary
        if: failure()
        run: |
          {
            echo '## fa-extension.zip NOT shipped this release'
            echo ''
            echo 'The extension build job failed (continue-on-error: the gh-1832 gate strands the release without it). See the failed steps above.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  release-provenance:

arguments.newText: Release-train recovery playbook (gh-1845, 2026-10-24): when a v* tag run's "Sign release checksums" (release-provenance) fails with "release <tag> is missing 1 required asset(s): fa-extension.zip — BLOCKING the publish", the fix is NOT code: dispatch the producer with an explicit tag — `gh workflow run build-macos.yml --ref <tag> -f version=<tag> -f create_release=true` (its build-extension job is ubuntu-latest, fast, and adopts the existing draft via scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh) — wait for fa-extension.zip to appear on the release, then `gh run rerun <tag-run-id> --failed`. Root pattern: build-macos.yml build-extension derives "latest+1 at its own dispatch moment" and runs ~once daily, so any tag train landing after the daily leg has no fa-extension.zip and the gh-1832 gate correctly strands it as a draft (seen stuck: v1.0.637, v1.0.638 on 2026-10-24). "Advance vpinned marker" failing right after is downstream noise (pin_release.sh refuses to pin unsigned releases) — it self-heals once provenance lands. Note: gh run view --json jobs returns only the latest attempt; failed release-tail jobs may be absent from a stale ci-red ticket's job list if the report was filed before the tail finished. Also: a rerun --failed never resurrects SKIPPED jobs (e.g. Installer smoke) — benign, the Quality gate treats skipped as neutral. Systemic fix (follow-up gh-1847) LANDED the same day: the tag train builds fa-extension.zip itself (ci.yml build-extension, an additive continue-on-error leg mirroring web-spa; release-provenance needs it so the gh-1832 gate never races the attach), so a draft stranded on the missing zip now self-heals with a plain `gh run rerun <tag-run-id> --failed` — the manual producer dispatch above survives only as the fallback for a red or flaky extension leg, and the daily build-macos leg was kept as the next-tag-draft pre-stager.

outputs/response.md
outputs ignored
  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension (release)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-gate
    timeout-minutes: 30
    # Additive REQUIRED asset, same semantics as web-spa: an SDK flake or
    # vendor-fetch hiccup must NOT hold CLI provenance hostage — the
    # release-provenance required-assets gate (gh-1832) is the single
    # publish blocker and strands the draft loudly on the MISSING asset
    # (previous release stays latest). continue-on-error keeps the check
    # green; the failed steps stay visible on the run page.
    continue-on-error: true
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) ||
      github.event_name == 'release')
    permissions:
      contents: write # attach fa-extension.zip to the GitHub Release
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Blobless full history: the lazy draft create (gh-1801 rework)
          # builds the release body via scripts/release_notes.sh — same
          # reason as the web-spa job's checkout (gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      # gh-1684 decision 4 + #1431 exact-patch pin: the SAME pinned SDK
      # every other fa-extension.zip leg carries (extension-size-gate,
      # build-macos.yml build-extension) — the rev normalization absorbs
      # canvaskit/skwasm churn, the pin keeps every build comparable.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as the PR-time
      # extension-size-gate leg and build-macos.yml build-extension.
      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what the landing page's releases/latest/download link
      # serves. Identical invocation as the PR-time gate leg (gh-1684 AC3)
      # and the build-macos.yml release leg.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096) + gh-1684 AC5: one baseline, one enforcement rule — the
      # IDENTICAL invocation the extension-size-gate PR leg and the
      # build-macos.yml release leg run, gate BEFORE upload (a budget
      # regression must not reach the release assets). Baseline is
      # committed — no --init-if-missing here.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      # gh-1801 (rework): DRAFT-first, NEVER publish here. fa-extension.zip
      # is a gh-1832 REQUIRED asset, but even a complete asset set must not
      # go live without the SIGNED SHA256SUMS — only the tag-run
      # release-provenance job owns the --draft=false --latest flip. Create
      # the draft with the curated notes + the draft-owner marker and
      # upload; --clobber keeps the stable asset name pointing at the
      # newest build. No guard step ON PURPOSE (same reasoning as web-spa):
      # this job is continue-on-error — on failure the train (binaries →
      # provenance) CONTINUES and must find the draft alive; a genuinely
      # orphaned draft is reclaimed by the 24h sweeper.
      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"
          bash scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          gh release upload "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Mirror of the web-spa summary flag: surface the miss in the run's
      # step summary (covers build/size-gate/upload flakes); the failed
      # steps remain visible in the job view. The release-provenance
      # required-assets gate is what actually blocks the publish.
      - name: Flag missing extension in step summary
        if: failure()
        run: |
          {
            echo '## fa-extension.zip NOT shipped this release'
            echo ''
            echo 'The extension build job failed (continue-on-error: the gh-1832 gate strands the release without it). See the failed steps above.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # SEC-07 (#795): the installer's default trust path is SIGNED checksums.
  # This job aggregates every fa-* asset of the release into SHA256SUMS and
  # signs it with the FA_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY repo secret (openssl RSA —
  # already available on runners, no new dependency). The signing key is a
  # channel separate from the release assets, so a checksum file served from
  # the same compromised source as the binary cannot vouch for itself.
  # Fail-closed: without the secret the release publishes NO provenance and
  # this job goes red — install.sh aborts with E_PROVENANCE_MISSING on it.
  # Needs web-spa (#1100, continue-on-error) and build-extension
  # (gh-1847, continue-on-error) for ordering only: the web bundle and
  # the extension zip cannot hold CLI provenance hostage. The ordering
  # makes the fa-* sweep deterministic — web-spa/extension success ->
  # zip signed, failure -> zip absent — never a half-updated manifest,
  # and the gh-1832 gate below never races a slow attach.
  release-provenance:
